metadata.case_name: CHAK CHUN ON v. TAI CHUNG WAH AND ANOTHER

source: The Plaintiff sustained rupture of right Achilles tendon.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia or tendon at ankle or foot level

injuries.description: abrasion scar on right forearm (ulnar side) 10 x 10 cm
source: (i) Right forearm – abrasion scar on ulnar side 10 x 10 cm, flat, soft, barely noticeable;
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified parts of forearm

injuries.description: abrasion scar on right leg (shin) 46 x 5 mm, flat, soft, thin, deeply pigmented in mid portion
source: (ii) Right leg – abrasion scar 46 x 5 mm on the shin, flat, soft, thin, deeply pigmented in mid portion;
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified parts of lower leg

injuries.description: linear scar on right foot medial border 2 x 45 mm, raisrd firm, pigmented with scaling
source: (a) medial border – linear scar 2 x 45 mm, raisrd firm, pigmented with scaling;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of ankle or foot

injuries.description: vertical hypertrophic scar on postero-medial side of the Tendo Archilles 143 x 6.5 mm, raised, thick, firm and pigmented
injuries.body_part: postero-medial side of the Tendo Archilles (right)
source: (b) postero-medial side of the Tendo Archilles, vertical hypertrophic scar 143 x 6.5 mm, raised, thick, firm and pigmented;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: scars on left shoulder (visible scar identified by orthopaedic experts)
source: The orthopaedic experts indentified visible scars, inter alia, on her right leg and left shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the shoulder or upper arm

source: She recovered after operations, scars were left on various places of her body.

the scars were a result of an operation underwent by the Plaintiff on 12th January 2009, it is optional for the Plaintiff to decide whether to undergo cosmetic surgery to improve the appearance of the existing scars.

losses.description: She claims damages for future medical expenses for plastic surgical treatments to improve her appearance; scars were left on various places of her body.
